zh: {player}{player}，早上好呀！
en: {player}, {player}, good morning!

zh: 这周上什么课？
en: What lessons do we have this week?

zh: 方舟为{girl}准备了一整套成长课程。等到地面恢复的那一天，{girl}要带着这些本领回到地球。
en: The Ark has prepared a full curriculum for {girl}. On the day the surface recovers, {girl} will return to Earth with these skills.

zh: 由你为{girl}安排接下来 7 天的课，每天一门，可以重复。点"结束本周"后，{girl}会按课表去上课。
en: You will plan {girl}'s lessons for the next 7 days, one per day. Lessons may repeat. After you press "End Week", {girl} will attend lessons according to the schedule.

zh: 机械、生态、通信三门课，教{girl}修理机器、照顾植物、联络远方。
en: Mechanics, Ecology and Communications teach {girl} to repair machines, care for plants and reach faraway places.

zh: 上课会消耗体力。体力太低时学得慢，降到 0 当天会生病，记得给{girl}留出休息的日子。
en: Classes use stamina. With low stamina she learns slowly; at 0 she gets sick that day. Remember to leave rest days.

zh: 等我都学会了，回地球以后，坏掉的东西我统统修好！
en: Once I learn everything, I'm gonna go back to Earth and fix every broken thing!

zh: 好，就这么上！
en: Okay, let's do it!

zh: 你可以和{girl}聊天。每周能聊的轮数有限，{girl}越信任你、心情越好，能聊得越多。
en: You can chat with {girl}. Chat rounds per week are limited; the more she trusts you and the better her mood, the more you can talk.

zh: 你怎么回应{girl}，会慢慢改变{girl}。
en: How you respond to {girl} will gradually change her.

zh: {player}，窗户外面那个圆圆的，就是地球吗？
en: {player}, that round thing outside the window, is that Earth?

zh: 结束本周？{girl}会按课表上 7 天课。
en: End this week? {girl} will attend 7 days of lessons according to the schedule.

zh: {player}，我跟你说个秘密。
en: {player}, I'll tell you a secret.

zh: 档案课上说，这个窗户是一块大屏幕，平时放的地球是画漂亮了的。
en: In archive class it said this window is actually a big screen, and the Earth it usually shows is made to look prettier.

zh: 我找到按钮了！我们看一下真的地球，好不好？
en: I found the button! Let's look at the real Earth, okay?

zh: 观景窗 · 实时画面
en: Viewport · Live Feed

zh: ……灰灰的。
en: …It's all gray.

zh: 档案里说，地球上的草和树都生病了，变成灰灰的，碰都不能碰。
en: The archives said all the grass and trees on Earth got sick and turned gray, and you can't even touch them.

zh: 可是地球那么大，肯定有一棵绿色的、没生病的躲起来了，对不对？
en: But Earth is sooo big. There's gotta be one green tree that didn't get sick, hiding somewhere, right?

zh: 嗯！那它好勇敢呀，一个人在那里。
en: Yeah! Then it's really brave, being all alone out there.

zh: 对！我们种！种好多好多棵！
en: Yeah! We'll plant them! Lots and lots of them!

zh: 想！我长大了就去找它，跟它说你好。
en: Yes! When I grow up, I'll go find it and say hello.

zh: 嗯……{player}说的话，我记住啦。
en: Mm... I'll remember what you said, {player}.

zh: 等我长大了，我要把地球修好。
en: When I grow up, I'm gonna fix the Earth.

zh: ……还是这样好看。
en: …It looks nicer like this.

zh: 晚安，{player}。
en: Good night, {player}.

zh: 第 2 周
en: Week 2

zh: 说不定真的有。
en: Maybe there really is.

zh: 就算没有，以后也会有的。
en: Even if there isn't, there will be someday.

zh: 你想看见它吗？
en: Do you want to see it?
